text: dsh-file-convert 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 的本地文件转换插件，通过注册工具并在 Desktop 会话中挂载拖拽式转换页面，处理图片、PDF、JSON、YAML、CSV、音视频及 Office 文件。它提供单文件与批量转换、格式检查、按目标体积压缩、OCR、转换能力查询和本地网页操作。适合希望让 DSH 代理在本机整理与转换文件的用户；无需 API 密钥，部分格式需要可选系统工具。

dsh-file-convert lets DSH agents convert files locally through tools and a drag-and-drop page. It handles images, PDFs, data, media, and Office formats, plus batch jobs, inspection, size optimization, and OCR. No API key is needed; some formats require optional system tools.
我想让 DSH 代理直接把本地文件转成别的格式。
有没有办法批量把一个目录里的图片转成 WebP？
扫描版 PDF 能不能识别文字并导出成文本？
想先检查文件实际格式和页数，再决定怎么处理。
能帮我把大文件压到指定体积吗？
我希望在 DSH 会话里用拖放页面转换文件。
Let my DSH agent convert files on this computer without sending them to a service.
I need to inspect a document and see which conversions this machine can handle.
dsh-file-convert 的功能「单文件格式转换：调用 convert_file 并指定输入路径和目标格式，可设置输出位置、覆盖、质量、页码范围或 OCR；结果写到本机文件。
dsh-file-convert 的功能「目录批量转换：调用 batch_convert 指定目录和目标格式，可按源格式筛选并设置输出目录；工具返回转换、跳过和失败汇总。
dsh-file-convert 的功能「转换前检查：调用 inspect_file 查看按文件内容识别的格式及可用信息，帮助判断后续转换方式。
dsh-file-convert 的功能「按目标体积优化：调用 optimize_file 处理支持的图片、视频或 PDF；实现按格式选择编码、质量搜索或 Ghostscript 预设。
dsh-file-convert 的功能「拖放网页转换：Desktop 会话可使用挂载的文件转换页面，也可调用 open_ui 启动独立本地页面；支持在浏览器中选择文件和下载结果。
dsh-file-convert 的媒体依赖安装工具会从 npmmirror 下载 FFmpeg，失败时改用 GitHub；OCR 语言数据也需显式下载并缓存到本机。

dsh-file-convert README · dsh-file-convert：**Local-first file conversion for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

Convert images, PDFs and data files directly inside your DSH agent sessions — no API keys, no uploads, no servers, no token cost for the conversion itself. Files never leave your machine.

> **Unofficial community plugin.** Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

dsh-file-convert README · dsh-file-convert：> **Compatibility:** v1.1.x supports DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1** through explicit peer-version branches, tested against separate runtime dependency graphs. The v1.0.x baseline remains available for 0.2.1-rc.5. Other hosts require separate verification. Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` is required. See [installation, upgrades and rollback](./STABILITY.md).

dsh-file-convert README · Why：Agents constantly need file conversions: "turn this PDF into images", "give me that JSON as YAML", "convert all JPGs in this folder to WebP". Instead of shelling out or pasting data around, `dsh-file-convert` gives your agent eight purpose-built tools backed by battle-tested local libraries.

dsh-file-convert README · Why：- ✅ **Local execution** — files never leave the machine
- ✅ **No API key, no server, no conversion tokens**
- ✅ **Natural language friendly** — the agent calls the tools, you just ask
- ✅ **Batch conversions** with a compact summary
- ✅ **Honest failures** — missing dependency, unsupported pair, existing output: every error says exactly why
- ✅ **Images, PDF and data need zero external binaries** — prebuilt npm packages only. Media needs one tool (ffmpeg), clearly reported when missing

dsh-file-convert README · Supported conversions：| Source | Targets |
| --- | --- |
| PNG, JPG, WEBP | PNG, JPG, WEBP (any-to-any) |
| SVG | PNG, JPG, WEBP |
| PDF | PNG, JPG, TXT |
| JSON | YAML, CSV |
| YAML | JSON, CSV |
| DOCX, PPTX, XLSX | PDF |
| PDF | PNG, JPG, TXT, DOCX (experimental); TXT supports OCR for scanned PDFs |
| MP4 | GIF, MP3 |
| MOV | MP4 |
| WAV | MP3 |
| CSV | JSON, YAML |

dsh-file-convert README · Supported conversions：26 conversions. Images, PDF and data work out of the box via `npm install`. Optional tools unlock the rest, each clearly reported by `list_conversions` when missing:

dsh-file-convert README · Supported conversions：- **FFmpeg** -> media rows. Install it system-wide (preferred for untrusted media), **or ask the agent to run `install_media_dependencies`** — it downloads pinned current builds (FFmpeg 6.1.1, ~56 MB total, one time) into the plugin cache, sha256-verified, from the npmmirror binary CDN with the GitHub release as fallback.
- **LibreOffice** -> DOCX/PPTX/XLSX to PDF. `winget install TheDocumentFoundation.LibreOffice` / `brew install --cask libreoffice` / `apt install libreoffice`.
- **Ghostscript** -> PDF compression in `optimize_file`.
- **Python + pdf2docx** -> the experimental PDF to DOCX row (`pip install pdf2docx`).
- **Tesseract** (optional) -> faster OCR for scanned PDFs; without it the bundled tesseract.js is used and its language data is fetched explicitly via `install_ocr_dependencies` (`winget install UB-Mannheim.TesseractOCR`).

dsh-file-convert README · Install：Inside a DSH profile — three ways, easiest first:

```sh
dsh-file-convert README · 1. from npm (once published)：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-file-convert@1.1.0 --save-exact

dsh-file-convert README · 2. straight from GitHub (a `prepare` build runs; allow it once)：dsh plugin --profile default add github:zzy-12345678/dsh-file-convert
```

Git installs may ask you to allow the build step in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-file-convert: true
```

> **First-install note**: pnpm may also ask you to decide on a build script for `tesseract.js` (it only shows a donation notice — skipping is safe). Set it in the same file and re-run the install:
>
> ```yaml
> allowBuilds:
>   tesseract.js: false
> ```

text:
dsh-file-convert README · `convert_file`：Convert one file.

```json
{ "input": "/tmp/report.pdf", "output_format": "png", "dpi": 200 }
```

```
Converted: /tmp/report.pdf (pdf) -> /tmp/report.png (png)
1.2 MB -> 431.0 KB in 1.4s
```

dsh-file-convert README · `convert_file`：- Default output: next to the input file, same base name, new extension.
- Multi-page PDFs produce `<name>-<page>.<ext>` for every page; `pages: "1-3,5"` selects pages (outputs keep their real page numbers, text joins only the selection).
- Scanned PDFs → TXT: `ocr: true` (optionally `ocr_lang`, default `chi_sim+eng`) recognizes the rendered pages instead of the text layer. Engine priority: a local Tesseract CLI, then the bundled tesseract.js (whose language data is never downloaded implicitly — run `install_ocr_dependencies` first, about 10-30 MB per language).
- Existing outputs are refused unless `overwrite: true`.
- Options: `output`, `overwrite`, `quality` (1–100), `dpi` (PDF/SVG rasterization), `pages`, `ocr`, `ocr_lang`.

dsh-file-convert README · `batch_convert`：Convert every matching file in a directory (top level).

```json
{ "input_dir": "/home/me/Pictures", "output_format": "webp" }
```

```
Batch convert in /home/me/Pictures -> WEBP
Converted: 18, skipped: 2, failed: 0
Output dir: /home/me/Pictures/output
```

- `input_format` filters by source format; omit it to auto-detect every convertible file.
- `output_dir` defaults to `<input_dir>/output`.
- Existing outputs are **skipped** (not overwritten) unless `overwrite: true`.

dsh-file-convert README · `inspect_file`：Facts before action, detected from file content — not just the extension:

```json
{ "input": "/tmp/scan.pdf" }
```

```json
{ "kind": "pdf", "pages": 24, "encrypted": false, "likelyScanned": true, "bytes": 13000000 }
```

dsh-file-convert README · `optimize_file`：Shrink a file toward a target size instead of converting it:

```json
{ "input": "video.mp4", "target_size_mb": 20 }
```

```
Optimized: video.mp4 (mp4) -> video-min.mp4
18.3 MB -> 19.7 MB (target 20 MB) in 41.2s
Applied: two-pass x264: video 512k + audio 128k over 185.0s
```

dsh-file-convert README · `optimize_file`：- MP4/MOV: two-pass x264, the video bitrate is computed from the target (audio 128k, dropping to 64k for tight targets); output is always MP4. Requires ffmpeg + ffprobe.
- JPG/WEBP: binary-searches the highest encoder quality that fits; PNG uses palette reduction. No external tools needed.
- PDF: Ghostscript quality presets (printer/ebook/screen), first preset that fits the target wins; requires Ghostscript.
- Targets below what the codec can physically reach are refused with the achievable minimum.
- GIF optimization is not supported yet.

dsh-file-convert README · `install_media_dependencies`：One-call media setup: downloads pinned FFmpeg 6.1.1 static builds (ffmpeg + ffprobe) into the plugin cache (`~/.dsh-file-convert/bin`), verifies the pinned sha256, and proves the binaries run before reporting success. Served from the npmmirror binary CDN with the GitHub release as a byte-identical fallback. System installs keep priority over the cache. Ask the user for consent first — it is a sizable download.

dsh-file-convert README · `install_ocr_dependencies`：Downloads the tesseract.js language data (about 10-30 MB per language, `chi_sim+eng` by default) into the plugin cache, so `ocr: true` works without a local Tesseract. Skips when a local Tesseract CLI is installed or the data is already cached. Ask the user for consent first — conversions never download language data implicitly.

dsh-file-convert README · `list_conversions`：All 26 conversions with their live availability on *this* machine — unavailable rows name the missing tool and how to install it. Images, PDF and data rows are usable out of the box; media, office and PDF-compression rows depend on the optional tools (media can even be set up by the agent via `install_media_dependencies`).

dsh-file-convert README · `open_ui`：Open the local drag-and-drop web UI from inside a DSH session. The first call starts the server inside the plugin process and opens the browser; later calls return the running URL without starting anything twice. In DSH Desktop the converter is also always available as a native "文件转换" tab in the conversation view — `open_ui` is only needed when you want it in a separate browser window.

```json
{}
```

```
dsh-file-convert UI is running at http://127.0.0.1:5757/ (opened in your browser; ...)
```

dsh-file-convert README · Local web UI (drag & drop)：The engine ships with a zero-dependency web app: drag files into the browser, pick a target format, download the result. Everything runs on your machine. It is available two ways:

dsh-file-convert README · Local web UI (drag & drop)：- **Native in DSH Desktop** (default): the plugin mounts the app at `/dsh-file-convert` on the DSH web server and injects a client bundle that adds a "文件转换" tab to the conversation view — click the tab and the converter appears in place, no extra server. The iframe talks to the same origin, and the DSH host's own gate protects it.
- **Standalone** (`npm run ui`, or ask the agent to call `open_ui`): its own server on `http://127.0.0.1:5757` (walks up to the next free port if taken), gated by a random per-session token. Useful outside DSH or when you want the converter in a normal browser window.

dsh-file-convert README · Local web UI (drag & drop)：- **Drag & drop** files (or click to browse); jobs queue one by one with upload progress, warnings and per-file download links. Multi-page PDFs produce one download per page.
- The target-format picker is driven by the live capability matrix (the same data as `list_conversions`), so unavailable pairs are hidden and the real detected input format corrects a wrong guess after the first attempt.
- Closing the tab mid-conversion aborts the underlying work (the same true-cancellation semantics as the tools).
- Standalone security: binds to `127.0.0.1` only and refuses any other interface; every API call requires a random per-session token.
- Standalone flags: `--port` (default 5757), `--no-open`, `--timeout-min` (default 30 per conversion), `--max-upload-mb` (default 2048).

dsh-file-convert README · Plugin config：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `quality` | `85` | Default JPEG/WebP quality (1–100) |
| `dpi` | `150` | Default rasterization DPI for PDF inputs |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Cooperative timeout for one conversion |
| `maxInputMb` | `2048` | Refuse inputs above this size (MB) |
| `maxPdfPages` | `200` | Full-document PDF rasterization refuses more pages; use `pages` for larger documents |
| `maxOutputPixels` | `16000000` | Clamp rasterized pixels per page (width × height) to this budget |
| `uiAutoStart` | `false` | Start the web UI as soon as the plugin loads (otherwise the agent starts it on demand via `open_ui`) |
| `uiTimeoutMin` | `30` | Per-conversion deadline inside the web UI (longer than `timeoutMs` because UI users convert long videos) |
| `batchMaxFiles` | `500` | Max files examined per `batch_convert` run; beyond it the summary reports what was skipped instead of silently capping |
| `outputRoots` | `[]` | When non-empty, explicit `output` paths must resolve inside one of these directories (recommended for shared deployments; the default next-to-input output is always exempt) |
| `ffmpegPath` / `ffprobePath` | -

dsh-file-convert README · Plugin config：**Limit coverage**: `maxInputMb` applies to convert, batch, inspect and optimize alike; `maxPdfPages` applies to PDF rasterization and text extraction (both implicit full-document runs and explicit `pages` selections); `maxOutputPixels` applies to PDF rasterization, OCR rendering and SVG rasterization.

dsh-file-convert README · Plugin config：**What `timeoutMs` cancellation stops**: external binaries are killed mid-run (ffmpeg, LibreOffice, Ghostscript, Tesseract CLI); an in-flight PDF page render is cancelled through pdf.js's render task; tesseract.js recognition is stopped by terminating its worker; pure-JS pipelines (sharp encoding, JSON/YAML/CSV parsing) are interrupted at every step boundary and never write output after an abort. One large synchronous step (a single sharp encode or `JSON.parse`) cannot be interrupted mid-flight — its result is discarded instead of written. Every final-path write is atomic (sibling temp file + rename), so an aborted conversion never leaves a half-written file behind.

dsh-file-convert README · Architecture：```
                         DSH
                          │
                    dsh-file-convert
           ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐

dsh-file-convert README · Architecture：- **Declarative matrix**: every conversion is a data row (`{ from, to }`) on its converter. Routing, `list_conversions` and dependency checks are all derived from it.
- **Detection**: content first - binary magic (file-type), SVG sniffing, and JSON parsing (plus a YAML document-marker guess for extension-less files) - with the extension as fallback. Conflicts resolve in favor of the content, with a warning.
- **Core is DSH-agnostic**: `src/core` never imports Cordis/DSH, so the engine can be unit-tested, wrapped in a CLI, or served over MCP later. If the DSH developer-preview API shifts, only the glue layer changes.
- **Dependencies**: external binaries (FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Poppler) are *detected, never auto-installed* — `list_conversions` reports them and prints per-platform install hints. The interface is already in place (`BinaryDependency`).

dsh-file-convert README · Development：Use npm 11.6.2 for dependency resolution (also pinned in CI). With an older npm, run `npx --yes npm@11.6.2 ci`. Keep the committed lockfile; do not use `--legacy-peer-deps` to generate a different dependency graph.

```sh
npm ci            # npm 11.6.2; installs the locked dependency graph
npm run build     # tsc -> lib/
npm test          # release-metadata checks + Vitest (optional tools gate some suites)
npm run smoke     # end-to-end against lib/

dsh-file-convert README · Development：On Windows, `scripts\prepare-release.cmd` installs, validates, tests and packs the current version. It stops at the first failure and does not push tags or publish. The release workflow checks that `v<version>` matches both manifests before publishing through OIDC.

dsh-file-convert README · Development：To recover a partially completed release, run the **Release** workflow manually on `main` with the existing tag (for example `v0.5.2`). It checks out that tag, reruns validation, skips npm publishing only when the published package belongs to the exact tagged commit, and creates the GitHub release only if it is missing. Temporary API failures are retried.

dsh-file-convert README · Development：Local development pulls the dsh-tools peer closure into `devDependencies` so typecheck and vitest can load the 0.2.1 tool registry. End users of the published plugin do not install these — the host profile provides them.

Add a conversion = add one capability row + implement it in a converter. Add a backend = implement the `Converter` interface and register it in `createRouter()`.

dsh-file-convert README · Fidelity & safety expectations：- **Lossy by nature**: PDF→DOCX (experimental), OCR and office→PDF are reconstructions — expect layout and recognition differences. `inspect_file`'s `likelyScanned` flag tells you when OCR is the right tool, and results carry warnings.
- **Cached ffmpeg builds**: the download convenience installs pinned sha256-verified FFmpeg 6.1.1 static builds. For untrusted media, a current system FFmpeg takes priority — prefer it in security-sensitive setups.
- **Not a sandbox**: `outputRoots` resolves symlinks and resource limits (`maxInputMb`, `maxPdfPages`, `maxOutputPixels`, `batchMaxFiles`) cap runaway jobs, but the default next-to-input output is intentionally exempt from roots, and an agent that may write files can always write somewhere. For hostile multi-tenant use, add OS-level isolation on top.

| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness Desktop | 0.2.1-rc.5 |
| DeepSeek Harness Desktop (additional baseline) | 0.2.2-rc.1 |
| @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools | `0.2.1-rc.5` or `0.2.2-rc.1`, matching the host |

dsh-file-convert README · Compatibility：The 1.0.x line keeps its original 0.2.1-rc.5 baseline; 1.1.x adds 0.2.2-rc.1 while retaining the older host. The complete old peer graph is built and tested separately with `npm run test:compat`; normal CI uses the new graph. The client injects the conversation package, which owns the view slot, without requesting retired framework packages. `defineTool` argument validation and host compatibility checks remain enabled. Other DSH release candidates are not implicitly supported. See [STABILITY.md](./STABILITY.md).

dsh-file-convert README · Roadmap：- ~~V0.2 — Media (FFmpeg)~~ **shipped**: MP4→GIF/MP3, WAV→MP3, MOV→MP4, plus `optimize_file` with target-size two-pass encoding.
- ~~V0.3 — Office + PDF tooling~~ **shipped**: DOCX/PPTX/XLSX→PDF via LibreOffice, experimental PDF→DOCX via python pdf2docx, PDF compression via Ghostscript; on-demand dependency downloads with an automatic CN mirror.
- ~~V0.4 — OCR (Tesseract)~~ **shipped**: PDF→TXT supports `ocr: true` (optional `ocr_lang`), local Tesseract CLI first with the bundled tesseract.js as fallback, language data fetched explicitly via `install_ocr_dependencies`.
- ~~V0.5 — Local web UI~~ **shipped**: drag & drop app with a live capability matrix, hosted natively in DSH Desktop as a "文件转换" conversation tab (`webServer` mount + client bundle) with a standalone `open_ui` fallback; Chinese-first user-facing text; true cancellation and atomic writes extended to every path.
- Later: OCR → DOCX for scanned PDFs, conversion chains (PPTX→PDF→PNG), video downscaling in `optimize_file`, resize/rotate image options.

dsh-file-convert README · License：[MIT](./LICENSE). dsh-file-convert distributes no external binaries; runtime libraries (sharp, pdfjs-dist, @napi-rs/canvas, js-yaml, csv) are installed from npm under their own licenses.

dsh-file-convert README · dsh-file-convert：**为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 打造的本地优先文件转换插件。**

dsh-file-convert README · 为什么做这个：Agent 日常需要各种格式转换："把这个 PDF 转成图片"、"把这个 JSON 变成 YAML"、"把文件夹里所有 JPG 转成 WebP"。`dsh-file-convert` 提供八个专用 tool，背后是久经考验的本地库，你只需用自然语言提需求。

- ✅ **本地执行** —— 文件不出机器
- ✅ **不要 API Key、不要服务器、不耗转换 Token**
- ✅ **自然语言友好** —— Agent 调 tool，你直接说话
- ✅ **批量转换**，返回紧凑的结果摘要

- ✅ **图片/PDF/数据零外部依赖** —— npm 预编译包装完即用；音视频只依赖 ffmpeg，缺了会明确提示

> **首次安装提示**：pnpm 还可能要求你决定 `tesseract.js` 的构建脚本是否执行（它只是捐赠提示，跳过毫无影响）。在同一个文件里加上：
>
> ```yaml
> allowBuilds:
>   tesseract.js: false
> ```
>
> 然后重新执行安装命令即可。

text:
dsh-file-convert README · `convert_file` —— 单文件转换：```json
{ "input": "/tmp/report.pdf", "output_format": "png", "dpi": 200 }
```

- 默认输出到源文件同目录、同名换后缀。
- 多页 PDF 会为每一页输出 `<文件名>-<页码>.<后缀>`；`pages: "1-3,5"` 选择页码（输出保留真实页码，TXT 只拼接所选页）。
- 扫描件 PDF → TXT：`ocr: true`（可选 `ocr_lang`，默认 `chi_sim+eng`）对渲染页面做识别，而不是读文本层。引擎优先本机 Tesseract CLI，其次插件内置的 tesseract.js（语言数据不会随转换隐式下载——先让 Agent 跑 `install_ocr_dependencies`，约每种语言 10-30 MB）。
- 输出文件已存在时默认拒绝，需显式 `overwrite: true`。
- 可选参数：`output`、`overwrite`、`quality`（1–100）、`dpi`（PDF/SVG 光栅化）、`pages`、`ocr`、`ocr_lang`。

dsh-file-convert README · `batch_convert` —— 目录批量转换：```json
{ "input_dir": "/home/me/Pictures", "output_format": "webp" }
```

- `input_format` 可按源格式过滤；不传则自动探测所有可转换文件。
- `output_dir` 默认为 `<input_dir>/output`。
- 已存在的输出默认**跳过**（不覆盖），`overwrite: true` 时替换。

dsh-file-convert README · `inspect_file` —— 转换前先看清楚：基于文件内容（magic bytes）而非扩展名识别格式：

```json
{ "kind": "pdf", "pages": 24, "encrypted": false, "likelyScanned": true, "bytes": 13000000 }
```

图片返回尺寸/通道数，数据文件返回记录数。`likelyScanned: true` 提示这可能是扫描件——转 TXT 时加 `ocr: true` 即可识别。

dsh-file-convert README · `optimize_file` —— 按目标体积压缩：PDF 走 Ghostscript 三档预设（printer/ebook/screen）自动迭代：某档已达标就停，全超则保留最小档并如实告知。需要 Ghostscript（`winget install ArtifexSoftware.GhostScript`）。

```json
{ "input": "video.mp4", "target_size_mb": 20 }
```

- MP4/MOV：两遍编码 x264，按目标体积反推视频码率（音频 128k，紧张时降到 64k），输出统一为 MP4，需要 ffmpeg + ffprobe。
- JPG/WEBP：二分搜索能塞进目标体积的最高编码质量；PNG 走调色板压缩。图片不需要任何外部工具。
- 目标体积低于编码物理下限时直接拒绝，并给出可达的最低体积。
- GIF/PDF 压缩暂不支持。

dsh-file-convert README · `install_media_dependencies` —— 一键补齐媒体依赖：下载固定的 FFmpeg 6.1.1 静态构建（ffmpeg + ffprobe 两个 ~28 MB 文件）到插件缓存（`~/.dsh-file-convert/bin`），校验钉死的 sha256，并真实执行一次二进制确认可用后才报告成功。npmmirror 二进制 CDN 优先，GitHub release 为字节一致的回退源。系统安装的 ffmpeg 优先于缓存。体积可观，调用前请先征得用户同意。

dsh-file-convert README · `install_ocr_dependencies` —— 一键补齐 OCR 语言包：把 tesseract.js 的语言数据（默认 `chi_sim+eng`，约每种语言 10-30 MB）下载进插件缓存（`~/.dsh-file-convert/tessdata`），让 `ocr: true` 在没有本机 Tesseract 时也能工作。已装本机 Tesseract 或语言包已缓存时跳过。体积可观，调用前请先征得用户同意——转换路径绝不隐式下载语言数据。

text: dsh-file-convert README · `list_conversions` —— 当前机器的能力清单：列出全部 26 种转换在当前机器上的实时可用状态；某项不可用时，明确指出缺哪个外部工具并给出安装提示。图片/PDF/数据类开箱即用，音视频、Office、PDF 压缩依赖可选工具（媒体依赖还能由 Agent 经 `install_media_dependencies` 自动补齐）。

dsh-file-convert README · `open_ui`：在 DSH 会话里打开本地拖拽转换网页。首次调用会在插件进程内启动 UI 服务器并打开浏览器；再次调用直接返回已运行实例的地址，不会重复起进程。在 DSH Desktop 里转换器还常驻为会话视图中的「文件转换」标签页——`open_ui` 只在你想用独立浏览器窗口时才需要。

dsh-file-convert README · 本地 Web UI（拖拽转换）：引擎自带一个零依赖的网页应用：把文件拖进浏览器、选目标格式、下载结果，全程不出本机。有两种打开方式：

- **DSH Desktop 原生集成**（默认）：插件把应用挂载到 DSH Web 服务器的 `/dsh-file-convert` 路径，并注入客户端 bundle，在会话视图里添加一个「文件转换」标签页——点开即用，无需额外服务器；iframe 与宿主同源，由 DSH 自身的访问控制保护。
- **独立运行**（`npm run ui`，或让 Agent 调用 `open_ui`）：独立服务器 `http://127.0.0.1:5757`（端口被占用时自动顺延），由随机会话 token 保护。适合在 DSH 之外或想在普通浏览器窗口使用时。

两种模式功能一致：
section: 本地 Web UI（拖拽转换）

text:
dsh-file-convert README · 本地 Web UI（拖拽转换）：- **拖入文件**（或点击选择）即可转换；任务逐个排队，显示上传进度、警告信息与逐文件下载链接。多页 PDF 按页生成多个下载。
- 目标格式下拉框由实时能力矩阵（与 `list_conversions` 同源数据）驱动：不可用的组合不会出现，首次尝试后真实检测出的输入格式会纠正错误猜测。
- 转换中关闭标签页会真正中止底层工作（与工具相同的真取消语义）。
- 独立模式安全默认值：只绑定 `127.0.0.1`，拒绝其他网卡；所有 API 都需要随机会话 token。
- 独立模式启动参数：`--port`（默认 5757）、`--no-open`、`--timeout-min`（默认 30 分钟/次）、`--max-upload-mb`（默认 2048）。

dsh-file-convert README · 插件配置：| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `quality` | `85` | JPEG/WebP 默认质量（1–100） |
| `dpi` | `150` | PDF 光栅化默认 DPI |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次转换的协作式超时（毫秒） |
| `maxInputMb` | `2048` | 拒绝超过此大小（MB）的输入 |
| `maxPdfPages` | `200` | 整本 PDF 光栅化超过此页数即拒绝；更大的文档请用 `pages` 选择 |
| `maxOutputPixels` | `16000000` | 每页光栅化像素（宽 × 高）钳制到此预算 |
| `uiAutoStart` | `false` | 插件加载时立即启动本地 Web UI（否则由 Agent 按需经 `open_ui` 启动） |
| `uiTimeoutMin` | `30` | Web UI 内单次转换的超时（分钟；默认比 `timeoutMs` 宽，因为 UI 用户常转长视频） |
| `batchMaxFiles` | `500` | 每次 `batch_convert` 最多检查的文件数；超出时会在结果里明确报告跳过了多少，而不是静默截断 |
| `outputRoots` | `[]` | 非空时，显式指定的 `output` 路径必须落在这些目录之内（共享部署建议开启；默认写到输入文件旁的输出不受限） |
| `ffmpegPath` / `ffprobePath` | - | ffmpeg 不在 PATH 时（Windows 常见）手动指定二进制路径 |
| `sofficePath` / `ghostscriptPath` / `pythonPath` / `tesseractPath` | - | 各可选工具的手动路径，优先于自动探测 |

dsh-file-convert README · 插件配置：**限制覆盖范围**：`maxInputMb` 作用于 convert / batch / inspect / optimize 全部入口；`maxPdfPages` 作用于 PDF 光栅化与文本提取（隐式整本与显式 `pages` 选择都受限）；`maxOutputPixels` 作用于 PDF 光栅化、OCR 渲染和 SVG 光栅化。

**`timeoutMs` 取消的真实覆盖面**：外部二进制进程会被当场终止（ffmpeg、LibreOffice、Ghostscript、Tesseract CLI）；进行中的 PDF 页面渲染通过 pdf.js 渲染任务取消；tesseract.js 识别通过终止 worker 真正停止；纯 JS 流程（sharp 编码、JSON/YAML/CSV 解析）在每个步骤边界被中断，且中止后绝不写出输出文件。单个较大的同步步骤（一次 sharp 编码或一次 `JSON.parse`）无法在中途打断，但其结果会被丢弃而不是落盘。所有最终路径的写入都是原子的（兄弟临时文件 + 重命名），中止的转换不会留下写了一半的文件。

dsh-file-convert README · 架构：- **声明式转换矩阵**：每条转换是 converter 上的一行数据（`{ from, to }`），Router 路由、`list_conversions`、依赖检查全部由此推导。
- **格式识别**：内容优先——二进制 magic（file-type）、SVG 嗅探、JSON 解析（无扩展名文件还会尝试 YAML 文档标记猜测）——扩展名兜底；两者冲突以内容为准并给出 warning。
- **核心与 DSH 解耦**：`src/core` 不依赖 Cordis/DSH，可直接单测、包 CLI、将来包 MCP server。DSH developer preview 的 API 若有破坏性变更，只需改胶水层。
- **依赖管理**：外部二进制（FFmpeg/LibreOffice/Poppler）只做**检测，绝不自动安装**——`list_conversions` 报告缺失并给出各平台安装提示。接口已就位（`BinaryDependency`）。

dsh-file-convert README · 开发：依赖解析统一使用 npm 11.6.2（CI 同样固定此版本）。本机 npm 较旧时运行 `npx --yes npm@11.6.2 ci`。保留仓库中的锁文件，不用 `--legacy-peer-deps` 生成另一套依赖图。

```sh
npm ci            # 使用 npm 11.6.2 和已提交的锁文件
npm run build     # tsc -> lib/
npm test          # 发布元数据检查 + Vitest，部分套件需要可选工具
npm run smoke     # 针对 lib/ 的端到端冒烟测试

Windows 可运行 `scripts\prepare-release.cmd`，依次安装、构建、测试和打包，任一步失败立即停止。脚本只做本地准备；推送标签和发布是独立操作。发布工作流会检查 `v<版本号>` 与包及锁文件一致后再通过 OIDC 发布。

dsh-file-convert README · 开发：若发布只完成了一部分，可在 `main` 上手动运行 **Release** 工作流，填写原标签（例如 `v0.5.2`）。流程检出该标签并重新验证；仅当 npm 包确实来自同一标签提交时才跳过发布，GitHub Release 已存在则核验通过，缺失时创建，并重试临时 API 故障。

本地开发会在 `devDependencies` 里拉齐 dsh-tools 的 peer 闭包，便于 typecheck 与 vitest 加载 0.2.1 工具注册表。最终用户安装插件时不需要这些——由宿主 profile 提供。

加一种转换 = 在 converter 的能力表里加一行数据并实现它。加一类后端 = 实现 `Converter` 接口并在 `createRouter()` 注册。

dsh-file-convert README · 保真度与安全预期：- **天然有损**：PDF→DOCX（实验性）、OCR、office→PDF 都是重建——版式和识别误差不可避免。`inspect_file` 的 `likelyScanned` 标记帮你判断何时该用 OCR，结果里会带警告。
- **缓存版 ffmpeg**：便捷下载安装的是钉死 sha256 的 FFmpeg 6.1.1 静态构建。处理不可信媒体时，新版系统 FFmpeg 优先——安全敏感场景请优先系统安装。
- **不是沙箱**：`outputRoots` 会解析符号链接，资源上限（`maxInputMb`、`maxPdfPages`、`maxOutputPixels`、`batchMaxFiles`）能拦住失控任务，但默认"写到输入文件旁"的输出有意不受 roots 约束，且能写文件的 Agent 总能找到地方写。敌对多租户场景请在操作系统层再加隔离。
